rich.25409c03de2f.source:
Failure mode: stale embeddings.

A vector index is a cache of an embedding model's outputs. Production systems have to defend against a few specific failures:

  • Swap the embedding model and every cached vector becomes meaningless until you re-embed every passage.
  • The provider silently upgrades the model, and scores drift with no error raised.
  • Two services share an index but pin different model ids; the index returns nonsense to one of them.

A reliable index pins the embedding model id alongside each cached vector and refuses to mix versions. The canonical pin for this course is nvidia/nemotron-3-embed-1b, served by integrate.api.nvidia.com through the course relay.
rich.25409c03de2f.value:
故障模式：陈旧的嵌入。

向量索引是嵌入模型输出的缓存。生产系统必须防范以下几种特定故障：

  • 一旦更换嵌入模型，所有缓存向量都会失去意义，直到您重新嵌入每个段落。
  • 提供商悄悄升级模型，分数随之漂移，却不会触发任何错误。
  • 两个服务共享同一索引，却固定使用不同的模型 ID；该索引会向其中一个服务返回毫无意义的结果。

可靠的索引会为每个缓存向量同时固定嵌入模型 ID，并拒绝混用不同版本。本课程的规范固定值是 nvidia/nemotron-3-embed-1b，由 integrate.api.nvidia.com 通过课程代理提供服务。

rich.83b4d689d50b.source:
Embedding API contract.

The embeddings endpoint takes a JSON request with three fields and returns one array of vectors:

  • input is the batch of texts to embed, typed string[].
  • model names the embedding model, typed string.
  • input_type is either "query" or "passage".
  • The response carries a data array whose entries each hold an embedding of number[].

The NVIDIA embedding model uses input_type to distinguish queries from passages. Its retrieval training aims to match questions with passages that answer them. Reversing "query" and "passage" can change the scores and reduce retrieval quality without causing an API error. Check the types and evaluate the returned passages.
rich.83b4d689d50b.value:
嵌入 API 契约。

嵌入 API 入口接收包含三个字段的 JSON 请求，并返回一个向量数组：

  • input 是待嵌入的文本批次，类型为 string[]。
  • model 指定嵌入模型，类型为 string。
  • input_type 的值为 "query" 或 "passage"。
  • 响应包含一个 data 数组，其中每个条目都包含embedding，其类型为 number[]。

NVIDIA 嵌入模型使用 input_type 区分查询与段落。其检索训练旨在让问题与能回答问题的段落匹配。将 "query" 与 "passage" 互换可能改变分数并降低检索质量，而不会造成 API 错误。请检查类型，并评估返回的段落。

text.96a4f1c854c2.source: ReAct (Reason+Act) is the classic agent loop. The model is given the user's task plus a set of tools. At each iteration the model emits either a tool call request or a final answer. When a tool call is requested, the host code executes the tool, appends the result as an observation, and the model continues. The loop terminates when finish_reason is 'stop' and there are no tool_calls. The pattern's strength is that each step adapts to the previous step's observation; its weakness is sequential cost: N steps means N model calls in order.
text.96a4f1c854c2.value: ReAct（Reason+Act）是经典的智能体循环。模型会收到用户任务和一组工具。在每次迭代中，模型会输出工具调用请求或最终答案。如果模型请求调用工具，宿主代码就会执行该工具，将结果作为观察追加到上下文中，然后由模型继续处理。当 finish_reason 为“stop”且不存在 tool_calls 时，循环终止。这种模式的优势在于，每一步都能根据上一步的观察结果进行调整；劣势则是顺序执行成本：N 个步骤意味着必须依次调用模型 N 次。

text.ab36f417fde3.source: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) injects external knowledge into the model's context at inference time. A document corpus is embedded once and stored in a vector index.
